Description
Available November 1 for a minimum 6-month lease. Spacious, fully furnished 3 bedroom, 2-bathroom condo at Pacific Plaza in the heart of Yaletown. This beautifully updated 1,240 sq. ft. home offers a thoughtful layout with ample storage, modern finishes, comfortable furnishings, and a move-in-ready setup. Enjoy stunning False Creek views and unbeatable convenience just steps from the Canada Line, parks, grocery stores, restaurants, cafés, and shops. Residents can enjoy well-maintained amenities including an indoor pool, jacuzzi, and fitness centre. Includes 1 parking stall, in-suite laundry, and all utilities for added comfort and value. A perfect home for anyone looking for space, convenience, and vibrant downtown living with everything right at their doorstep. Nader (604) 786 - 5884
